info.title: Vela CLI — Build Dataverse with confidence
info.description: Vela command-line tool (command: vela). Plan/apply, scaffolding and package signing for Microsoft Dataverse plugins and Custom APIs.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Register Dataverse plugins and Custom APIs from your build packages.

commands.name: add
commands.description:
Add a plugin, service, Custom API, test, or step to a project.
(plugin|service|customapi|test|step) <Name> [...]   run 'vela add --help' for the full options

options.name: --auth-client-id
options.description: Override the MSAL public client id used for --interactive browser login.

options.name: --authority
options.description:
Override the MSAL authority (e.g. for sovereign clouds).
--verbose also prints full exception stack traces on failure.

commands.name: add

(plugin|service|customapi|test|step) <Name> [...]   run 'vela add --help' for the full options

commands.name: apply
commands.description:
Same inputs as plan; add --execute to write the changes.
[same args as plan] [--solution <solutionUniqueName>] [--webresources <folder> (preview)] [--execute] [--strict] [--verbose]

commands.name: init
commands.description:
Scaffold a new solution on disk (aliases: new).
--name <SolutionName> [--prefix <Prefix>] [--output <dir>] [--no-integrations] [--no-tests] [--no-console] [--core-version <ver>] [--managed-identity] [--web-resources (preview) [--web-resources-namespace <name>] [--web-resources-folder <dir>]] [--json] [--force] [--interactive]

commands.name: inspect
commands.description:
Compare local packages with the live environment.
[same args as plan] [--verbose]

commands.name: menu
commands.description: Launch the interactive menu (default with no args).

commands.name: models
commands.description:
Generate early-bound model classes.
(--solution <uniquename> | --entities <a,b,c>) [--namespace <ns>] [--out <dir>] [--no-annotations] [--overwrite] [--forms and/or --tables (preview, TypeScript)] [connection options]

commands.name: plan
commands.description:
Preview registration changes; never writes to Dataverse.
[--package <plugin.nupkg>]... [--packages-dir <folder>] [--package-assembly <name.dll>] [--webresources <folder> (preview)] [connection options] [--environment <label>] [--out <file>] [--interactive] [--strict] [--verbose]

commands.description:

commands.description:
Generate early-bound model classes.
(--solution <uniquename> | --entities <a,b,c>) [--namespace <ns>] [--out <dir>] [--no-annotations] [--overwrite] [--forms and/or --tables (preview, TypeScript)] [connection options]

options.name: --solution
options.description: tables taken from the solution's components

options.name: --entities
options.description: explicit table logical names (combinable with --solution)

options.name: --custom-apis
options.description: Custom API unique names → typed Request/Response message classes

options.name: --roles
options.description: security role names → a dependency-light Roles class (root role id + privileges)

options.name: --solution-roles
options.description: also generate every security role in --solution

options.name: --forms
options.description: (preview) emit vela-client TypeScript FormModel files for the scoped tables' Main/QuickCreate forms (TypeScript; --lang optional)

options.name: --tables
options.description:
(preview) emit vela-client TypeScript Web API record interfaces (tables/<name>.ts) for the scoped tables (TypeScript; --lang optional)
(--forms and --tables can be combined: one run emits both plus a shared option-sets/ folder and one index.ts barrel)

options.name: --namespace
options.description: output namespace (default: <prefix>.Shared.Models.Generated, inferred from the project)

options.name: --out
options.description: output directory (default: current directory)

options.name: --json
options.description: print a JSON report of the generated files (for scripts/agents)

options.name: --no-annotations
options.description: omit DataAnnotations ([StringLength]/[Range])

options.name: --overwrite
options.description:
overwrite existing files
connection: --connection-string | --url + --tenant-id + --client-id + --client-secret | --interactive
